image_description: A computer speaker system set against a white background. The set includes a central black subwoofer unit with two control knobs on the front and circular driver openings on the sides, flanked by two smaller silver satellite speakers on stands. A small black wired remote or controller is also visible in the foreground.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: One or more circular speaker cones on front face of varying sizes.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The front face of the main subwoofer features control knobs and a display panel, not speaker cones. The actual drivers appear to be mounted on the side panels (visible as grey circles), which deviates from the 'front face' description in the checkpoint.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Prominent large woofer dominating the front face with a much smaller tweeter positioned above or beside it.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: This specific configuration (large woofer + small tweeter on the *front*) is not present. The front has controls. The side-mounted drivers do not show a distinct tweeter/woofer separation on the front plane.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Cone surface made of paper, polypropylene, or composite with rubber surround.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The speaker cones are located on the side of the subwoofer and are partially obscured or lack sufficient resolution to verify material composition (paper/rubber surround). The satellite speakers have grilles covering the drivers.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Grille cloth or perforated metal may cover the drivers.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The satellite speakers clearly feature a silver perforated metal grille covering the front driver area.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Terminal connections visible on rear panel.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The image shows the front and side views; the rear panel where terminal connections would be located is completely occluded.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Wood, MDF, or plastic enclosure with black, white, or wood-grain finish.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The subwoofer appears to be black plastic or painted MDF, and the satellites are silver plastic/metal. This fits the material description.
The object is identifiable as a speaker system, which functions as an electro-acoustic transducer.
The presence of volume/bass knobs and speaker drivers confirms its function as an audio output device.

artifact_observations.location: Front panel of the subwoofer (above the knobs)
artifact_observations.reasoning: There is text/logo area on the top front edge of the subwoofer that appears blurry and illegible, typical of AI-generated text artifacts, though it mimics a brand logo placement.

The circular driver housings on the left and right sides of the subwoofer appear slightly warped and non-concentric. The inner cone details are muddy and lack the precise geometric definition of real manufactured speaker components.

The oval badges on the base of the satellite speakers have inconsistent perspective relative to the stand geometry, appearing slightly flattened or skewed in a way that doesn't perfectly match the vanishing point of the rest of the object.

Legibility and structure of text/logos on the front panel
